description: Start a capability job and return its id immediately (paid). Use when execution is required but this MCP call must not block — not for quotes or status checks. Prefer hydracept_run when waiting is acceptable. Poll with hydracept_job_status. Same billing as hydracept_run. Requires bearer key. Returns: Job admission envelope with jobId and nextAction poll. Errors: WORKSPACE_KEY_REQUIRED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FundingRequired, EXECUTION_FAILED.
